title: Choose the visual world — MK Auto Body
question: The roll assigned The Masked Booth. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Masked Booth
options.lineage: A car masked in white paper and cut tape inside MK's own paint booth
options.thesis: The page is a car in the booth: masked, taped on the logo's shear angle, then peeled to the finish.
options.viewport: White masking-paper ground; a huge black headline cut on the logo's diagonal; a real booth photo showing through a diagonal tape window; call button and 3-field quote form on the paper.
options.risk: If the tape cuts are timid it collapses into a generic white page with a red button.

raised.raise: One gesture transforms the surface: dragging the tape edge peels every before photo to its after.
One continuous tape line runs the whole page and rules every alignment.
Red is law: it appears only as paint and as the call to act, never as decoration.
Facts at monumental scale: 1997 and $500 set as display numerals.

options.label: The Paint Code Card
options.lineage: OEM paint-code labels and refinish colour-chip cards
options.thesis: Every section is a colour-chip card: MK matches your car from its OEM code.
options.viewport: A large chip card with the red swatch as the hero field, code-label typography for the headline, phone and quote in the label block.
options.risk: Tidy and familiar; reads as a paint supplier more than a collision shop.

options.label: Three-Ink Kiosk
options.lineage: restricted-ink kiosk print with a geometric office mark
options.thesis: Black, red and paper only: services sold like goods in one whole-cell kiosk grid.
options.viewport: A strict grid of service cells, the MK mark as the office emblem, the active cell printed red.
options.case: Holds product clarity (services scan instantly); loses audience identification, Ottawa drivers don't live in this print world.
options.risk: No photographs by rule, which throws away MK's best proof.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One pull turns a flat plane into a shaped volume.
options.viewport: A black semicircle that gathers on pull.
options.case: Loses both axes: fashion world, no link to repair.
options.kept: One gesture transforms the surface (the tape peel).

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: One traveling beam rules a continuous section.
options.viewport: A building in section with a sunbeam.
options.kept: One continuous line rules the whole page.

options.label: Night Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six gauges, each owning one truth.
options.case: Loses both axes: dashboards are the rut for car businesses.
options.kept: Each fact owns one fixed slot.

options.label: CRT Arcade
options.thesis: Palette law: each colour means one thing.
options.kept: Red reserved by law for paint and action.

options.label: Command Wall
options.case: Loses both axes: alarm for a stressed visitor.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark premium auto-shop hero: full-bleed car photo, white headline, red button, services row.
canonCard.viewport: Big photo of a finished car, headline and Get a Quote over it, icon cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every detailing and collision site by design.
